title: Add up the density below a cutoff
spoken: The energy density below cutoff frequency nu c is the integral of the spectral density from zero to nu c.
explanation: A density per unit frequency becomes an energy per unit volume only when it is added up over a range of frequencies. Here the range runs from zero to a cutoff.
assumptions: Each radiation mode in equilibrium carries the classical average energy k_B T.
A cutoff frequency nu_c; the model counts only frequencies below it.
These are modern teaching equations in SI notation; the paper writes L for c, R/N for k_B, and beta for B.

notes.title: Add up over frequency
notes.explanation: From zero to the cutoff: density times frequency width, summed.

notes.title: What it asserts
notes.explanation: The energy per volume is the area under the density curve up to the cutoff.

notes.title: Cutoff frequency
notes.explanation: The highest frequency the sum includes.

notes.title: Cutoff frequency
notes.explanation: The highest frequency the sum includes.

notes.title: Spectral energy density
notes.explanation: Radiation energy per cubic metre per unit of frequency.

notes.title: Energy density below the cutoff
notes.explanation: Energy per cubic metre in all frequencies up to the cutoff.
